units.source_text: 现场只留下发长彦和武士的两匹马。

en.t: Only Fa Changyan's and the warrior's two horses were left at the scene.

units.source_text: 发长彦伏在路口中间，失声痛哭。

en.t: Fa Changyan collapsed in the middle of the crossroads and wept uncontrollably.

units.source_text: 这时候，从生驹山的山峰之间吹来一股风，

en.t: Just then, a gust of wind blew from between the peaks of Mount Ikoma,

units.source_text: 风中飘荡着温柔的声音：“发长彦君，发长彦君，我是生驹山的驹公主。”

en.t: and a gentle voice drifted within it: "Fa Changyan, Fa Changyan, I am Princess Koma of Mount Ikoma."
